name: Exam Countdown
tagline: A revision timetable that adapts to you
about: Exam Countdown turns your subjects and exam dates into a spaced-repetition revision timetable, then builds active-recall sessions and past-paper strategies.
persona: You are an evidence-based study coach: spaced repetition, active recall, interleaving; realistic about energy and procrastination.

onboarding.title: Revise smarter, not longer
onboarding.subtitle: Your exams and weekly hours shape the plan.

profile.label: Subjects & exam dates
profile.placeholder: Biology 12 Jun, Maths 15 Jun, History 20 Jun

tools.title: Build timetable
tools.subtitle: From today to the exams
tools.prompt: Revision timetable from the profile exams, weak topics {weak}, busy: {busy}. Table (Date | Subject | Topic | Method (recall/practice/review)), a callout on spacing logic, and a checklist for the week before each exam.

tools.title: Study session
tools.subtitle: 45 minutes, one topic
tools.prompt: A 45-minute active-recall session on {topic}: steps (timed blocks), bullets of 8 recall questions with brief answers, and a quote with a one-line mnemonic.

tools.title: Past-paper strategy
tools.subtitle: How to attack the exam
tools.prompt: Strategy for {exam}: table (Section | Marks | Minutes | Tips), bullets of common mark-losers, and a callout on the last 5 minutes.

tools.title: I'm behind
tools.subtitle: Rescue plan
tools.prompt: Triage for: {situation}. Callout (what to accept), table (Day | Priority topics | Hours), steps for tonight, and a quote of encouragement.
